description: This file defines the CommentsController class in an ASP.NET Core application, handling HTTP requests related to comments on articles, including creating, retrieving, and deleting comments.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller class managing comment-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing MediatR for command/query dispatching.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for a specified article.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by ID from an article.
